clue.text: Warm coat extended some length

parts.note: a fur is a warm coat
extended means long, as in a long stay

explanation.surface: A warm coat that has been lengthened somewhat.
explanation.definitionFit: A furlong is a unit of distance, an eighth of a mile, used in horse racing.

clue.text: Wishing well — life's upset before throwing coin at it

indicators.note: before puts the first jumble ahead of the second
upset means the four letters are knocked out of order
throwing, as with pottery, reshapes the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: Tossing a coin into a wishing well after life has gone wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns LIFE into FELI; 'throwing' turns COIN AT IT into CITATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Felicitation is the act of congratulating someone, offering good wishes.

clue.text: Glance from wealthy alien holding company

indicators.note: holding means the word for wealthy wraps around the abbreviation

parts.note: wealthy means rich
ET is the film alien, the Extra-Terrestrial

explanation.surface: A look from a rich extraterrestrial who owns a firm.
explanation.definitionFit: To glance off something is to bounce off at an angle, which a ricocheting bullet does.

clue.text: Responsibility of working with United States

parts.note: a machine that is working is on

explanation.surface: The duty of working alongside America.
explanation.definitionFit: An onus is a burden or duty that falls to someone.

clue.text: Style of music coming back — for instance a piece by Joplin

indicators.note: coming back means the whole string is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: EG means for instance
Scott Joplin composed ragtime pieces, known as rags

explanation.surface: A musical style returning, such as a Scott Joplin tune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming back' reverses the whole string; Scott Joplin was the American ragtime composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Garage is a genre of electronic dance music that emerged in the 1980s and 90s.

clue.text: Tory EGM frantic about European subject

indicators.note: about means the jumbled letters go around the abbreviation
frantic suggests wild disorder, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Conservative extraordinary general meeting in a panic over Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'frantic' rearranges TORY EGM; 'about' wraps that round E. An EGM is an extraordinary general meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: Geometry is a school subject, the branch of mathematics dealing with shapes.

clue.text: Famous entertainer deserts, upset

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means the word is turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: to rat is to desert, as rats leave a sinking ship

explanation.surface: A celebrity performer walks out in a huff.
explanation.definitionFit: A star is a celebrated performer, a leading name in show business.

clue.text: Sterile space, it must be treated

indicators.note: letters that must be treated are processed and rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A sterile room has to be treated to stay clean.
explanation.walkthrough: 'must be treated' rearranges SPACE and IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Aseptic is the medical word for free from germs, a synonym of sterile.

clue.text: Turn down joint that's far from warm

definitions.meaning: to snub or reject someone pointedly
a chilled shoulder cut of meat, such as lamb

explanation.surface: Rejecting a dish of meat that has gone cold.
explanation.definitionFit: To give someone the cold shoulder is to snub them, and a cold shoulder of lamb is an unheated joint.

clue.text: Want, we hear, briefly to question hair product

indicators.note: says the word for want is heard, giving letters that sound the same

parts.note: to want is to lack

indicators.note: briefly cuts the last letter from the word for question

parts.note: to query is to question

explanation.surface: Someone asks briefly about wanting a hair product.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' gives LAC, sounding like LACK; 'briefly' trims QUERY to QUER.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacquer is a hairspray that holds a style in place.

clue.text: Mostly respect a large ship's commander

indicators.note: mostly means all but the last letter of the word for respect is kept

parts.note: to respect is to admire
L is the standard abbreviation for large, as on clothing sizes

explanation.surface: Respect for a big vessel's captain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mostly' drops the final E of ADMIRE.
explanation.definitionFit: An admiral is a senior naval officer commanding a fleet or flagship.

clue.text: Source for drug company has beginnings in Central America

indicators.note: beginnings asks for the opening letter of each of the next two words

explanation.surface: A drugs cartel with origins in Central America.
explanation.definitionFit: The coca plant's leaves are the raw material from which cocaine is made.

clue.text: One lets up with changes abounding

indicators.note: with changes says the letters of the preceding words are altered in order

explanation.surface: Someone eases off as things change and are plentiful.
explanation.definitionFit: Plenteous is a literary word for plentiful, existing in great supply.

clue.text: Multi-lingual parrot reportedly acquired outside Lima

indicators.note: reportedly means the parrot's name is given by how it is said, not spelt

parts.note: Polly is the traditional name for a pet parrot

indicators.note: outside means the word for acquired goes around the letter

parts.note: acquired means got
L is Lima in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A parrot that speaks many languages was bought outside Lima.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reportedly' gives only the sound of the parrot's name, so one L is lost; 'outside' wraps the word for acquired round L.
explanation.definitionFit: A polyglot speaks or writes several languages fluently.

clue.text: Sacrifice of iron circlet?

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
a ring is a small circlet

explanation.surface: Giving up a band of metal as a sacrifice.
explanation.definitionFit: An offering is something given to a deity, a sacrifice.

clue.text: Big guns badly interrupting main traffic route

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into the middle of the route word

parts.note: an artery is a main road carrying heavy traffic
ill means badly, as in ill-treated

explanation.surface: Heavy weapons poorly placed, blocking a major road.
explanation.definitionFit: Artillery is the collective term for large-calibre guns used in warfare.

clue.text: Queen to speak wildly? That's out of place

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen
to rant is to speak loudly and wildly

explanation.surface: Would it be improper for the Queen to talk wildly?
explanation.definitionFit: Errant means straying from the proper course, wandering off.

clue.text: List of options of chaps before university

indicators.note: before places the word for chaps ahead of the next piece

parts.note: chaps are men

explanation.surface: Choices for young men before they go to university.
explanation.definitionFit: A menu lists the dishes, or computer commands, from which one can choose.

clue.text: A number for instance in winter going topless

indicators.note: in puts the abbreviation inside the trimmed season word
going topless means the first letter of the season word is removed

parts.note: EG, short for exempli gratia, means for instance

explanation.surface: Someone braving the cold without a top, as a number of people do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going topless' drops the first letter of the season, leaving INTER; 'in' puts the abbreviation inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An integer is a whole number, with no fractional part.

clue.text: Area that's developed to west and north

explanation.surface: A district that has been built up on its western and northern sides.
explanation.definitionFit: A town is a built-up settlement, an area of urban development.

clue.text: Turn quickly in parking in serious error

indicators.note: in places the parking letter within the word for serious error

parts.note: a sin is a grave wrong
P is the road-sign abbreviation for parking

explanation.surface: A sharp turn while parking is a bad mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: To spin is to rotate rapidly on an axis.

clue.text: Practical computer program gave a false answer

parts.note: an app is a computer program
lied means told an untruth

explanation.surface: A useful piece of software gave a wrong result.
explanation.definitionFit: Applied science or maths is put to practical use, as opposed to theoretical.

clue.text: Bronwen's desperate for a fresh addition to the family

definitions.text: a fresh addition to the family

indicators.note: desperate suggests wild, disordered behaviour, so the name's letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Bronwen longs for another baby in the family.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desperate' rearranges BRONWEN, a Welsh woman's name; the 's is read as 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A newborn baby is the latest arrival in a family.

clue.text: Team boss has time for married bird

indicators.note: time for married means the letter for time replaces the letter for married

parts.note: a team boss is its manager

explanation.surface: A football manager makes time for a wedding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' swaps the M of MANAGER for T.
explanation.definitionFit: A tanager is a brightly coloured songbird of the Americas.
